content.name: Mules-Supply-Mod-OPUS
content.description: A supply-focused derivative of Mules, Supply and Warehouses Extended 6.60. Capacity-based fleet dispatch, multi-stop procurement, small-demand completion and per-ship diagnostics. See README.md for changes and test status.
content.author: Mules-Supply-Mod-OPUS contributors; based on MoistDreams, BHayden53, Galaxy Spam and earlier authors
